newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway shares edge down in mixed trade.
newsitem.headline: Norway shares edge down in mixed trade.

text.p: The Norwegian stock index weakened slightly in mixed trade on Monday amid profit-taking in some blue chips, dealers said.
Oslo's Total index fell 0.17 percent to 1,080.25 points in turnover of about one billion crowns.

Dealers reported some profit-taking in Saga Petroleum, whose A share fell 1.7 percent to 117 crowns. Christiania Bank was down 1.3 percent at 23.40 crowns while Fokus Bank fell 2.8 percent to 52 crowns.

But engineering and construction giant Kvaerner's A share was up 1.68 percent at 333.50 crowns, continuing a rise that dealers said was rooted in the fact that it recently had announced contracts amounting to more than 20 billion crowns.
Telecommunications group Nera topped the turnover at 76 million crowns, its share rising 1.59 percent to 320 crowns.
Other high-tech shares also rose, including tiny Alpatron which rose 10.3 percent to 2.14 crowns in healthy turnover of 68.2 million crowns.
